nodes.name: Electrodeposition of CoAl-LDH thin films
nodes.procedure: A series of CoAl-LDH thin films prepared by electrodeposition process. The amount of LDHs coated on the electrode surface varied with different electrodeposition times.

nodes.name: Hydrothermal synthesis of monometallic Ni2+Ni3+-LDHs
nodes.procedure: Monometallic Ni2+Ni3+-LDHs achieved by hydrothermal approach where partial oxidation of Ni2+ into Ni3+ takes place under hydrothermal conditions to remove non-capacitive Al3+ while maintaining layered structure.
nodes.source_text: monometallic Ni2+Ni3+-LDHs have been achieved by a hydrothermal approach and the oxidation of partial Ni2+ into Ni3+ takes place under hydrothermal conditions.40

nodes.name: Two-step synthesis of NiMn-LDH/CNTs
nodes.procedure: Conventional acid modification of CNTs introduces functional groups (-OH, -CO, -COO-), followed by in situ coprecipitation to graft NiMn-LDH nanosheets onto CNT backbone. Small LDH nanoplatelets form first on CNT surface at functional group sites, growing into nanoflakes that fully cover CNTs.

nodes.name: One-step hydrothermal NiAl-LDH/graphene
nodes.procedure: NiAl-LDHs/graphene composites prepared by one-step hydrothermal process. NiAl-LDHs formed face-to-face on graphene surface after addition of precipitation agent (NaOH).
nodes.source_text: Wang et al.118 prepared NiAl-LDHs/graphene composites by a friendly one-step hydrothermal process. It was found that NiAl-LDHs were formed face-to-face on the surface of graphene after the addition of a precipitation agent (NaOH).
